name: Kitayama Ryou
source: The protagonist whose lover [url=/c65163]Chitose[/url] died two years prior to the game's events. He used to have excellent grades and be quite proficient at sports, and was admired by everyone, but after Chitose's death, he lost his goal in life completely.
